## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit, e.g. `feat(web): add user search` or `fix(api): …`
      (it becomes the commit message on `main` and decides the next version)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] Breaking change? Title uses `!` (e.g. `feat(api)!: …`) and the description explains the migration
